title: Italian cases for the Consultant and cloud-routed chat
goal: Gauntlet cases in Italian and English for the Consultant advice and for a chat answer on a cloud route, run once on the routes the owner turns on
acceptance: Italian and English cases added to the Gauntlet pack (invented neutral data); a case that the Consultant is never sent a local-only note
Real-model run only with the owner's yes and a cloud key (F-157); until then the cases run on fakes
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no keys, tokens, personal data or real Grover readings in Git.
escalation: Any run of a real model or a cloud call needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 from the code paths read for this plan. Not a measurement.
